title: The Book of Hebrews Decoded
author: Brittany Johnson
description: The Book of Hebrews — every verse decoded into plain, modern English (DMLV).

verses.kjv: God, who at sundry times and in divers manners spake in time past unto the fathers by the prophets,
verses.decoded: Long ago, God spoke many times and in many ways to our ancestors through the prophets.

verses.kjv: Hath in these last days spoken unto us by his Son, whom he hath appointed heir of all things, by whom also he made the worlds;
verses.decoded: But now, in these last days, he has spoken to us through his Son, whom he appointed to inherit everything, and through whom he created the universe.

verses.kjv: Who being the brightness of his glory, and the express image of his person, and upholding all things by the word of his power, when he had by himself purged our sins, sat down on the right hand of the Majesty on high;
verses.decoded: The Son is the shining glory of God and the exact representation of his being. He holds everything together by his powerful word. After he made purification for our sins, he sat down at the right side of the Majesty in heaven.

verses.kjv: Being made so much better than the angels, as he hath by inheritance obtained a more excellent name than they.
verses.decoded: He became much better than the angels because he inherited a more excellent name than theirs.

verses.kjv: For unto which of the angels said he at any time, Thou art my Son, this day have I begotten thee? And again, I will be to him a Father, and he shall be to me a Son?
verses.decoded: For to which of the angels did God ever say, 'You are my Son; today I have become your Father'? And again, 'I will be his Father, and he will be my Son'?

verses.kjv: And again, when he bringeth in the firstbegotten into the world, he saith, And let all the angels of God worship him.
verses.decoded: And when he brought the firstborn into the world, he said, 'Let all God's angels worship him.'

verses.kjv: And of the angels he saith, Who maketh his angels spirits, and his ministers a flame of fire.
verses.decoded: About the angels he says, 'He makes his angels spirits and his servants flames of fire.'

verses.kjv: But unto the Son he saith, Thy throne, O God, is for ever and ever: a sceptre of righteousness is the sceptre of thy kingdom.
verses.decoded: But about the Son he says, 'Your throne, O God, will last forever and ever. A scepter of justice is the scepter of your kingdom.'

verses.kjv: Thou hast loved righteousness, and hated iniquity; therefore God, even thy God, hath anointed thee with the oil of gladness above thy fellows.
verses.decoded: You loved justice and hated evil, so God, your God, has anointed you with the oil of joy more than your companions.

verses.kjv: And, Thou, Lord, in the beginning hast laid the foundation of the earth; and the heavens are the works of thine hands:
verses.decoded: You, Lord, laid the foundation of the earth in the beginning, and the heavens are the work of your hands.

verses.kjv: They shall perish; but thou remainest; and they all shall wax old as doth a garment;
verses.decoded: They will disappear, but you remain. They will all wear out like clothes.

verses.kjv: And as a vesture shalt thou fold them up, and they shall be changed: but thou art the same, and thy years shall not fail.
verses.decoded: You will fold them up like a coat, and they will be changed. But you remain the same, and your years will never end.

verses.kjv: But to which of the angels said he at any time, Sit on my right hand, until I make thine enemies thy footstool?
verses.decoded: But to which of the angels did God ever say, 'Sit at my right hand until I make your enemies a footstool for you'?

verses.kjv: Are they not all ministering spirits, sent forth to minister for them who shall be heirs of salvation?
verses.decoded: Aren't all angels spirits sent to serve those who will inherit salvation?

verses.kjv: Therefore we ought to give the more earnest heed to the things which we have heard, lest at any time we should let them slip.
verses.decoded: So we must pay even closer attention to what we have heard, to make sure we do not forget it.

verses.kjv: For if the word spoken by angels was stedfast, and every transgression and disobedience received a just recompence of reward;
verses.decoded: If the message given by angels was reliable, and every sin and disobedience received a fair punishment,

verses.kjv: How shall we escape, if we neglect so great salvation; which at the first began to be spoken by the Lord, and was confirmed unto us by them that heard him;
verses.decoded: how will we escape if we ignore such a great salvation? This salvation was first announced by the Lord, and those who heard him confirmed it to us.

verses.kjv: God also bearing them witness, both with signs and wonders, and with divers miracles, and gifts of the Holy Ghost, according to his own will?
verses.decoded: God also confirmed it by signs, wonders, many miracles, and gifts of the Holy Spirit, all according to his will.

verses.kjv: For unto the angels hath he not put in subjection the world to come, whereof we speak.
verses.decoded: God did not put the future world, which we are talking about, under the control of angels.

verses.kjv: But one in a certain place testified, saying, What is man, that thou art mindful of him? or the son of man, that thou visitest him?
verses.decoded: But someone somewhere said, 'What is man that you remember him? Or the son of man that you care for him?'

verses.kjv: Thou madest him a little lower than the angels; thou crownedst him with glory and honour, and didst set him over the works of thy hands:
verses.decoded: You made him only a little lower than the angels. You crowned him with glory and honor and put him in charge of everything you made.

verses.kjv: Thou hast put all things in subjection under his feet. For in that he put all in subjection under him, he left nothing that is not put under him. But now we see not yet all things put under him.
verses.decoded: You put everything under his control. God put everything under him. Nothing is left out. But we do not yet see everything under him.

verses.kjv: But we see Jesus, who was made a little lower than the angels for the suffering of death, crowned with glory and honour; that he by the grace of God should taste death for every man.
verses.decoded: But we see Jesus, who was made a little lower than the angels because he suffered death. He is now crowned with glory and honor so that by God's grace he might experience death for everyone.

verses.kjv: For it became him, for whom are all things, and by whom are all things, in bringing many sons unto glory, to make the captain of their salvation perfect through sufferings.
verses.decoded: It was fitting for the one for whom and by whom everything exists to make the leader of their salvation perfect through suffering, bringing many children to glory.

verses.kjv: For both he that sanctifieth and they who are sanctified are all of one: for which cause he is not ashamed to call them brethren,
verses.decoded: The one who makes people holy and those who are made holy are all from the same family. So Jesus is not ashamed to call them brothers and sisters.

verses.kjv: Saying, I will declare thy name unto my brethren, in the midst of the church will I sing praise unto thee.
verses.decoded: He says, 'I will tell my brothers and sisters your name. I will praise you among the congregation.'

verses.kjv: And again, I will put my trust in him. And again, Behold I and the children which God hath given me.
verses.decoded: And again, 'I will trust in him.' And again, 'Here I am, and the children God gave me.'

verses.kjv: Forasmuch then as the children are partakers of flesh and blood, he also himself likewise took part of the same; that through death he might destroy him that had the power of death, that is, the devil;
verses.decoded: Since the children share flesh and blood, Jesus also shared the same, so that through death he could destroy the one who holds the power of death, the devil.

verses.kjv: And deliver them who through fear of death were all their lifetime subject to bondage.
verses.decoded: And free those who were slaves all their lives because they feared death.

verses.kjv: For verily he took not on him the nature of angels; but he took on him the seed of Abraham.
verses.decoded: He did not take on the nature of angels, but he took on the nature of Abraham's descendants.

verses.kjv: Wherefore in all things it behoved him to be made like unto his brethren, that he might be a merciful and faithful high priest in things pertaining to God, to make reconciliation for the sins of the people.
verses.decoded: So he had to be made like his brothers and sisters in every way, to become a merciful and faithful high priest in service to God, to make a way to forgive the sins of the people.

verses.kjv: For in that he himself hath suffered being tempted, he is able to succour them that are tempted.
verses.decoded: Because he himself suffered when he was tempted, he is able to help those who are being tempted.

verses.kjv: Wherefore, holy brethren, partakers of the heavenly calling, consider the Apostle and High Priest of our profession, Christ Jesus;
verses.decoded: So, holy brothers and sisters who share in the heavenly calling, focus on the Apostle and High Priest we confess, Christ Jesus.

verses.kjv: Who was faithful to him that appointed him, as also Moses was faithful in all his house.
verses.decoded: He was faithful to the one who appointed him, just as Moses was faithful in all God's house.

verses.kjv: For this man was counted worthy of more glory than Moses, inasmuch as he who hath builded the house hath more honour than the house.
verses.decoded: But Christ is worthy of more glory than Moses, because the builder of a house has more honor than the house itself.

verses.kjv: For every house is builded by some man; but he that built all things is God.
verses.decoded: Every house is built by someone, but God is the one who made everything.

verses.kjv: And Moses verily was faithful in all his house, as a servant, for a testimony of those things which were to be spoken after;
verses.decoded: Moses was faithful as a servant in all God's house, to show what was going to be said later.

verses.kjv: But Christ as a son over his own house; whose house are we, if we hold fast the confidence and the rejoicing of the hope firm unto the end.
verses.decoded: But Christ is like a son over God's house, and we are his house if we keep our confidence and hope until the end.

verses.kjv: Wherefore (as the Holy Ghost saith, To day if ye will hear his voice,
verses.decoded: So, as the Holy Spirit says, 'Today, if you hear his voice,

verses.kjv: Harden not your hearts, as in the provocation, in the day of temptation in the wilderness:
verses.decoded: do not harden your hearts like when you rebelled during the time of testing in the wilderness.

verses.kjv: When your fathers tempted me, proved me, and saw my works forty years.
verses.decoded: Your ancestors tested me and tried me, and saw what I did for forty years.

verses.kjv: Wherefore I was grieved with that generation, and said, They do alway err in their heart; and they have not known my ways.
verses.decoded: That is why I was angry with that generation and said, They always go wrong in their hearts and have not known my ways.

verses.kjv: Take heed, brethren, lest there be in any of you an evil heart of unbelief, in departing from the living God.
verses.decoded: Be careful, brothers and sisters, that none of you has an evil, unbelieving heart that turns away from the living God.

verses.kjv: But exhort one another daily, while it is called To day; lest any of you be hardened through the deceitfulness of sin.
verses.decoded: Encourage each other every day while it is still called 'Today,' so that none of you becomes hard because of sin's deception.

verses.kjv: For we are made partakers of Christ, if we hold the beginning of our confidence stedfast unto the end;
verses.decoded: We share in Christ if we keep our confidence firm until the end.

verses.kjv: While it is said, To day if ye will hear his voice, harden not your hearts, as in the provocation.
verses.decoded: As it says, 'Today, if you hear his voice, do not harden your hearts as you did before.'

verses.kjv: For some, when they had heard, did provoke: howbeit not all that came out of Egypt by Moses.
verses.decoded: Some who heard did rebel, but not all who left Egypt with Moses.

verses.kjv: But with whom was he grieved forty years? was it not with them that had sinned, whose carcases fell in the wilderness?
verses.decoded: Who was God angry with for forty years? Was it not those who sinned, whose bodies fell in the wilderness?

verses.kjv: And to whom sware he that they should not enter into his rest, but to them that believed not?
verses.decoded: And who did God promise would not enter his rest except those who did not believe?

verses.kjv: So we see that they could not enter in because of unbelief.
verses.decoded: So we see they could not enter because of unbelief.

verses.kjv: Let us therefore fear, lest, a promise being left us of entering into his rest, any of you should seem to come short of it.
verses.decoded: So we should be careful, because a promise still stands for us to enter his rest, and we don't want anyone to miss out on it.

verses.kjv: For unto us was the gospel preached, as well as unto them: but the word preached did not profit them, not being mixed with faith in them that heard it.
verses.decoded: The good news was preached to us just like it was to them, but the message did not help those who heard it without faith.

verses.kjv: For we which have believed do enter into rest, as he said, As I have sworn in my wrath, if they shall enter into my rest: although the works were finished from the foundation of the world.
verses.decoded: We who believe do enter that rest, as he said, 'I swore in my anger that they would not enter my rest,' even though the work was finished from the beginning of the world.

verses.kjv: For he spake in a certain place of the seventh day on this wise, And God did rest the seventh day from all his works.
verses.decoded: He spoke about the seventh day like this: 'God rested on the seventh day from all his work.'

verses.kjv: And in this place again, If they shall enter into my rest.
verses.decoded: And again he said, 'If they enter my rest.'

verses.kjv: Seeing therefore it remaineth that some must enter therein, and they to whom it was first preached entered not in because of unbelief:
verses.decoded: Since it is still true that some must enter that rest, and the people it was first preached to did not enter because they did not believe,

verses.kjv: Again, he limiteth a certain day, saying in David, To day, after so long a time; as it is said, To day if ye will hear his voice, harden not your hearts.
verses.decoded: God sets a certain day again, saying through David, 'Today, after all this time; if you hear his voice, do not harden your hearts.'

verses.kjv: For if Jesus had given them rest, then would he not afterward have spoken of another day.
verses.decoded: If Jesus had given them rest, he would not have spoken about another day later.

verses.kjv: There remaineth therefore a rest to the people of God.
verses.decoded: So there is still a rest left for God's people.

verses.kjv: For he that is entered into his rest, he also hath ceased from his own works, as God did from his.
verses.decoded: Anyone who enters his rest also stops working, just like God stopped working after his.

verses.kjv: Let us labour therefore to enter into that rest, lest any man fall after the same example of unbelief.
verses.decoded: So let us work hard to enter that rest, so no one follows the example of unbelief.

verses.kjv: For the word of God is quick, and powerful, and sharper than any twoedged sword, piercing even to the dividing asunder of soul and spirit, and of the joints and marrow, and is a discerner of the thoughts and intents of the heart.
verses.decoded: God's word is alive and powerful, sharper than any double-edged sword, cutting between soul and spirit, joints and marrow, and it judges the thoughts and intentions of the heart.

verses.kjv: Neither is there any creature that is not manifest in his sight: but all things are naked and opened unto the eyes of him with whom we have to do.
verses.decoded: Nothing is hidden from him; everything is open and clear to the eyes of God, with whom we have to do.

verses.kjv: Seeing then that we have a great high priest, that is passed into the heavens, Jesus the Son of God, let us hold fast our profession.
verses.decoded: Since we have a great high priest who has gone into heaven, Jesus the Son of God, let us hold firmly to our faith.

verses.kjv: For we have not an high priest which cannot be touched with the feeling of our infirmities; but was in all points tempted like as we are, yet without sin.
verses.decoded: We do not have a high priest who cannot understand our weaknesses; he was tempted in every way we are, but he did not sin.

verses.kjv: Let us therefore come boldly unto the throne of grace, that we may obtain mercy, and find grace to help in time of need.
verses.decoded: So let us confidently approach God's throne of grace to receive mercy and find grace to help us when we need it.

verses.kjv: For every high priest taken from among men is ordained for men in things pertaining to God, that he may offer both gifts and sacrifices for sins:
verses.decoded: Every high priest is chosen from among people to serve them in matters related to God, so he can offer gifts and sacrifices for sins.

verses.kjv: Who can have compassion on the ignorant, and on them that are out of the way; for that he himself also is compassed with infirmity.
verses.decoded: He can be kind to those who are ignorant and have gone the wrong way, because he himself is weak.

verses.kjv: And by reason hereof he ought, as for the people, so also for himself, to offer for sins.
verses.decoded: Because of this, he must offer sacrifices not only for the people but also for himself.

verses.kjv: And no man taketh this honour unto himself, but he that is called of God, as was Aaron.
verses.decoded: No one takes this honor on himself; he must be called by God, just like Aaron was.

verses.kjv: So also Christ glorified not himself to be made an high priest; but he that said unto him, Thou art my Son, to day have I begotten thee.
verses.decoded: Christ did not glorify himself to become a high priest, but the one who said to him, 'You are my Son; today I have become your Father.'

verses.kjv: As he saith also in another place, Thou art a priest for ever after the order of Melchisedec.
verses.decoded: And in another place he says, 'You are a priest forever, following the order of Melchizedek.'

verses.kjv: Who in the days of his flesh, when he had offered up prayers and supplications with strong crying and tears unto him that was able to save him from death, and was heard in that he feared;
verses.decoded: During the time he lived as a man, he offered prayers and requests with loud cries and tears to the one who could save him from death, and his prayers were heard because of his reverence.

verses.kjv: Though he were a Son, yet learned he obedience by the things which he suffered;
verses.decoded: Even though he was God's Son, he learned obedience through the suffering he experienced.

verses.kjv: And being made perfect, he became the author of eternal salvation unto all them that obey him;
verses.decoded: After he was made perfect, he became the source of eternal salvation for all who obey him.

verses.kjv: Called of God an high priest after the order of Melchisedec.
verses.decoded: He was appointed by God to be a high priest in the order of Melchizedek.

verses.kjv: Of whom we have many things to say, and hard to be uttered, seeing ye are dull of hearing.
verses.decoded: We have much to say about this, but it is hard to explain because you have become slow to understand.

verses.kjv: For when for the time ye ought to be teachers, ye have need that one teach you again which be the first principles of the oracles of God; and are become such as have need of milk, and not of strong meat.
verses.decoded: You should be teachers by now, but you still need someone to teach you the basic truths of God's word again. You need milk, not solid food.

verses.kjv: For every one that useth milk is unskilful in the word of righteousness: for he is a babe.
verses.decoded: Anyone who only drinks milk is not experienced in the word of righteousness because they are still like a baby.

verses.kjv: But strong meat belongeth to them that are of full age, even those who by reason of use have their senses exercised to discern both good and evil.
verses.decoded: But solid food is for those who are mature, who have trained their minds to understand the difference between right and wrong.

verses.kjv: Therefore leaving the principles of the doctrine of Christ, let us go on unto perfection; not laying again the foundation of repentance from dead works, and of faith toward God,
verses.decoded: So, leaving the basic teachings about Christ, let us move on to becoming mature, not starting again with the foundation of turning away from useless actions and trusting God,

verses.kjv: Of the doctrine of baptisms, and of laying on of hands, and of resurrection of the dead, and of eternal judgment.
verses.decoded: with teachings about baptisms, the laying on of hands, the resurrection of the dead, and eternal judgment.

verses.kjv: And this will we do, if God permit.
verses.decoded: And we will do this if God allows.

verses.kjv: For it is impossible for those who were once enlightened, and have tasted of the heavenly gift, and were made partakers of the Holy Ghost,
verses.decoded: It is impossible for those who were once enlightened, who have experienced the heavenly gift and shared in the Holy Spirit,

verses.kjv: And have tasted the good word of God, and the powers of the world to come,
verses.decoded: who have tasted God's good word and the powers of the coming age,

verses.kjv: If they shall fall away, to renew them again unto repentance; seeing they crucify to themselves the Son of God afresh, and put him to an open shame.
verses.decoded: if they fall away, to be brought back to repentance again, because they are crucifying the Son of God all over again and openly shaming him.

verses.kjv: For the earth which drinketh in the rain that cometh oft upon it, and bringeth forth herbs meet for them by whom it is dressed, receiveth blessing from God:
verses.decoded: The land that drinks in the rain often falling on it and produces useful plants for those who farm it receives God's blessing.

verses.kjv: But that which beareth thorns and briers is rejected, and is nigh unto cursing; whose end is to be burned.
verses.decoded: But the land that produces thorns and thistles is worthless and close to being cursed; its end is to be burned.

verses.kjv: But, beloved, we are persuaded better things of you, and things that accompany salvation, though we thus speak.
verses.decoded: But, dear friends, we are confident that you are better than that and that you will experience salvation, even though we speak this way.

verses.kjv: For God is not unrighteous to forget your work and labour of love, which ye have shewed toward his name, in that ye have ministered to the saints, and do minister.
verses.decoded: God is not unfair and will not forget the work and love you have shown for his name by helping his people and continuing to help them.

verses.kjv: And we desire that every one of you do shew the same diligence to the full assurance of hope unto the end:
verses.decoded: We want each of you to show the same eagerness to fully trust in hope until the end.

verses.kjv: That ye be not slothful, but followers of them who through faith and patience inherit the promises.
verses.decoded: Do not be lazy, but follow the example of those who through faith and patience receive what God promised.

verses.kjv: For when God made promise to Abraham, because he could swear by no greater, he sware by himself,
verses.decoded: When God made his promise to Abraham, since there was no one greater to swear by, he swore by himself,

verses.kjv: Saying, Surely blessing I will bless thee, and multiplying I will multiply thee.
verses.decoded: saying, 'I will surely bless you and multiply your descendants.'

verses.kjv: And so, after he had patiently endured, he obtained the promise.
verses.decoded: And after patiently waiting, Abraham received what was promised.

verses.kjv: For men verily swear by the greater: and an oath for confirmation is to them an end of all strife.
verses.decoded: People swear by someone greater, and an oath confirms what they say and ends all arguments.

verses.kjv: Wherein God, willing more abundantly to shew unto the heirs of promise the immutability of his counsel, confirmed it by an oath:
verses.decoded: God wanted to show the heirs of his promise even more clearly that his plan does not change, so he confirmed it with an oath.

verses.kjv: That by two immutable things, in which it was impossible for God to lie, we might have a strong consolation, who have fled for refuge to lay hold upon the hope set before us:
verses.decoded: This means we have two unchanging things to hold on to, in which it is impossible for God to lie, so we can be strongly encouraged as we run to take hold of the hope set before us.

verses.kjv: Which hope we have as an anchor of the soul, both sure and stedfast, and which entereth into that within the veil;
verses.decoded: This hope is like an anchor for our souls, firm and secure, reaching behind the curtain into the inner sanctuary.

verses.kjv: Whither the forerunner is for us entered, even Jesus, made an high priest for ever after the order of Melchisedec.
verses.decoded: Jesus has entered there ahead of us as our forerunner, becoming a high priest forever, in the order of Melchizedek.

verses.kjv: For this Melchisedec, king of Salem, priest of the most high God, who met Abraham returning from the slaughter of the kings, and blessed him;
verses.decoded: This Melchizedek was king of Salem and priest of the Most High God. He met Abraham returning from defeating the kings and blessed him.

verses.kjv: To whom also Abraham gave a tenth part of all; first being by interpretation King of righteousness, and after that also King of Salem, which is, King of peace;
verses.decoded: Abraham gave him a tenth of everything. His name means King of Righteousness, and later he was also called King of Salem, which means King of Peace.

verses.kjv: Without father, without mother, without descent, having neither beginning of days, nor end of life; but made like unto the Son of God; abideth a priest continually.
verses.decoded: He had no father or mother, no family line, no beginning or end of life. He is like the Son of God and remains a priest forever.

verses.kjv: Now consider how great this man was, unto whom even the patriarch Abraham gave the tenth of the spoils.
verses.decoded: Think about how great this man was, since even Abraham, the ancestor of the people, gave him a tenth of the spoils.

verses.kjv: And verily they that are of the sons of Levi, who receive the office of the priesthood, have a commandment to take tithes of the people according to the law, that is, of their brethren, though they come out of the loins of Abraham:
verses.decoded: Those from Levi’s family who become priests are commanded by the law to collect tithes from the people, even though they are Abraham’s descendants.

verses.kjv: But he whose descent is not counted from them received tithes of Abraham, and blessed him that had the promises.
verses.decoded: But this man, who is not from their family line, received tithes from Abraham and blessed the one who had the promises.

verses.kjv: And without all contradiction the less is blessed of the better.
verses.decoded: It is clear that the one who is less is blessed by the one who is greater.

verses.kjv: And here men that die receive tithes; but there he receiveth them, of whom it is witnessed that he liveth.
verses.decoded: Here, mortal men receive tithes, but there, the one who is testified to be alive receives them.

verses.kjv: And as I may so say, Levi also, who receiveth tithes, payed tithes in Abraham.
verses.decoded: In a way, Levi, who collects tithes, paid tithes through Abraham.

verses.kjv: For he was yet in the loins of his father, when Melchisedec met him.
verses.decoded: Levi was still in his ancestor’s body when Melchizedek met Abraham.

verses.kjv: If therefore perfection were by the Levitical priesthood, (for under it the people received the law,) what further need was there that another priest should rise after the order of Melchisedec, and not be called after the order of Aaron?
verses.decoded: If perfection came through the Levitical priesthood, under which the people received the law, why was there a need for another priest like Melchizedek, not from Aaron’s family?

verses.kjv: For the priesthood being changed, there is made of necessity a change also of the law.
verses.decoded: When the priesthood changes, the law must also change.

verses.kjv: For he of whom these things are spoken pertaineth to another tribe, of which no man gave attendance at the altar.
verses.decoded: The one being talked about belongs to a different tribe, one that has not served at the altar.

verses.kjv: For it is evident that our Lord sprang out of Juda; of which tribe Moses spake nothing concerning priesthood.
verses.decoded: It is clear that our Lord came from Judah, and Moses said nothing about priests from that tribe.

verses.kjv: And it is yet far more evident: for that after the similitude of Melchisedec there ariseth another priest,
verses.decoded: It is even clearer that another priest appears like Melchizedek,

verses.kjv: Who is made, not after the law of a carnal commandment, but after the power of an endless life.
verses.decoded: not based on a law about physical requirements, but on the power of an eternal life.

verses.kjv: For he testifieth, Thou art a priest for ever after the order of Melchisedec.
verses.decoded: He says, 'You are a priest forever, like Melchizedek.'

verses.kjv: For there is verily a disannulling of the commandment going before for the weakness and unprofitableness thereof.
verses.decoded: The earlier command is set aside because it was weak and useless.

verses.kjv: For the law made nothing perfect, but the bringing in of a better hope did; by the which we draw nigh unto God.
verses.decoded: The law did not make anything perfect, but a better hope was introduced, and through it we approach God.

verses.kjv: And inasmuch as not without an oath he was made priest:
verses.decoded: He became a priest with an oath,

verses.kjv: (For those priests were made without an oath; but this with an oath by him that said unto him, The Lord sware and will not repent, Thou art a priest for ever after the order of Melchisedec:)
verses.decoded: while the others became priests without an oath. But this one became a priest with an oath from the Lord, who said, 'The Lord swore and will not change his mind: You are a priest forever, like Melchizedek.'

verses.kjv: By so much was Jesus made a surety of a better testament.
verses.decoded: Because of this, Jesus became the guarantee of a better agreement.

verses.kjv: And they truly were many priests, because they were not suffered to continue by reason of death:
verses.decoded: There were many priests because death prevented them from continuing.

verses.kjv: But this man, because he continueth ever, hath an unchangeable priesthood.
verses.decoded: But Jesus lives forever and has an unchanging priesthood.

verses.kjv: Wherefore he is able also to save them to the uttermost that come unto God by him, seeing he ever liveth to make intercession for them.
verses.decoded: Therefore, he is able to save completely those who come to God through him, because he always lives to intercede for them.

verses.kjv: For such an high priest became us, who is holy, harmless, undefiled, separate from sinners, and made higher than the heavens;
verses.decoded: We need a high priest like this, holy, innocent, pure, separated from sinners, and exalted above the heavens.

verses.kjv: Who needeth not daily, as those high priests, to offer up sacrifice, first for his own sins, and then for the people's: for this he did once, when he offered up himself.
verses.decoded: He does not need to offer sacrifices every day like other high priests, first for his own sins and then for the people's. He did this once by offering himself.

verses.kjv: For the law maketh men high priests which have infirmity; but the word of the oath, which was since the law, maketh the Son, who is consecrated for evermore.
verses.decoded: The law appoints sinful men as high priests, but the promise given after the law appoints the Son, who is made perfect forever.

verses.kjv: Now of the things which we have spoken this is the sum: We have such an high priest, who is set on the right hand of the throne of the Majesty in the heavens;
verses.decoded: Now, the main point of what we have been saying is this: We have a high priest who sits at the right side of the throne of the majestic God in heaven.

verses.kjv: A minister of the sanctuary, and of the true tabernacle, which the Lord pitched, and not man.
verses.decoded: He is a servant in the true sanctuary and the real tabernacle that the Lord made, not a man.

verses.kjv: For every high priest is ordained to offer gifts and sacrifices: wherefore it is of necessity that this man have somewhat also to offer.
verses.decoded: Every high priest is appointed to offer gifts and sacrifices. So it is necessary for this one also to have something to offer.

verses.kjv: Who serve unto the example and shadow of heavenly things, as Moses was admonished of God when he was about to make the tabernacle: for, See, saith he, that thou make all things according to the pattern shewed to thee in the mount.
verses.decoded: They serve as a copy and shadow of the heavenly things, just as Moses was told by God when he was about to build the tabernacle: 'Make everything exactly as the pattern showed to you on the mountain.'

verses.kjv: But now hath he obtained a more excellent ministry, by how much also he is the mediator of a better covenant, which was established upon better promises.
verses.decoded: But now Jesus has received a better ministry, because he is the mediator of a better covenant, which is based on better promises.

verses.kjv: For if that first covenant had been faultless, then should no place have been sought for the second.
verses.decoded: If the first covenant had been faultless, there would have been no need to look for a second one.

verses.kjv: For finding fault with them, he saith, Behold, the days come, saith the Lord, when I will make a new covenant with the house of Israel and with the house of Judah:
verses.decoded: But God found fault with them and said, 'The time is coming, says the Lord, when I will make a new covenant with the people of Israel and Judah.'

verses.kjv: Not according to the covenant that I made with their fathers in the day when I took them by the hand to lead them out of the land of Egypt; because they continued not in my covenant, and I regarded them not, saith the Lord.
verses.decoded: It will not be like the covenant I made with their ancestors when I took them by the hand to lead them out of Egypt, because they did not continue to follow my covenant, and I did not care for them, says the Lord.

verses.kjv: For this is the covenant that I will make with the house of Israel after those days, saith the Lord; I will put my laws into their mind, and write them in their hearts: and I will be to them a God, and they shall be to me a people:
verses.decoded: But this is the covenant I will make with the people of Israel after that time, says the Lord: I will put my laws into their minds and write them on their hearts. I will be their God, and they will be my people.

verses.kjv: And they shall not teach every man his neighbour, and every man his brother, saying, Know the Lord: for all shall know me, from the least to the greatest.
verses.decoded: No one will need to teach their neighbor or brother to know the Lord, because everyone will know me, from the least to the greatest.

verses.kjv: For I will be merciful to their unrighteousness, and their sins and their iniquities will I remember no more.
verses.decoded: I will be merciful to their wrongdoings, and I will no longer remember their sins and lawlessness.

verses.kjv: In that he saith, A new covenant, he hath made the first old. Now that which decayeth and waxeth old is ready to vanish away.
verses.decoded: By calling this covenant 'new,' he has made the first one old. And what is old and aging is about to disappear.

verses.kjv: Then verily the first covenant had also ordinances of divine service, and a worldly sanctuary.
verses.decoded: The first agreement also had rules for worship and a physical sanctuary.

verses.kjv: For there was a tabernacle made; the first, wherein was the candlestick, and the table, and the shewbread; which is called the sanctuary.
verses.decoded: There was a tent made, the first one, which had the lampstand, the table, and the bread of the presence; this was called the sanctuary.

verses.kjv: And after the second veil, the tabernacle which is called the Holiest of all;
verses.decoded: Behind the second curtain was the tent called the Most Holy Place.

verses.kjv: Which had the golden censer, and the ark of the covenant overlaid round about with gold, wherein was the golden pot that had manna, and Aaron's rod that budded, and the tables of the covenant;
verses.decoded: It contained the golden incense burner and the goldcovered ark of the agreement, which held the golden jar of manna, Aaron's staff that had budded, and the stone tablets of the agreement.

verses.kjv: And over it the cherubims of glory shadowing the mercyseat; of which we cannot now speak particularly.
verses.decoded: Above it were the angels of glory protecting the mercy seat; we cannot now explain these things in detail.

verses.kjv: Now when these things were thus ordained, the priests went always into the first tabernacle, accomplishing the service of God.
verses.decoded: When these things were arranged this way, the priests always entered the first tent to perform their duties.

verses.kjv: But into the second went the high priest alone once every year, not without blood, which he offered for himself, and for the errors of the people:
verses.decoded: But the high priest alone entered the second tent once a year, not without blood, which he offered for himself and for the people's sins.

verses.kjv: The Holy Ghost this signifying, that the way into the holiest of all was not yet made manifest, while as the first tabernacle was yet standing:
verses.decoded: The Holy Spirit shows this, meaning that the way into the Most Holy Place was not yet open while the first tent was still standing.

verses.kjv: Which was a figure for the time then present, in which were offered both gifts and sacrifices, that could not make him that did the service perfect, as pertaining to the conscience;
verses.decoded: This was a symbol for the present time, when gifts and sacrifices were offered that could not make the worshiper perfect in conscience.

verses.kjv: Which stood only in meats and drinks, and divers washings, and carnal ordinances, imposed on them until the time of reformation.
verses.decoded: These rules concerned food and drink and various washings, and were only temporary, imposed until the time of change.

verses.kjv: But Christ being come an high priest of good things to come, by a greater and more perfect tabernacle, not made with hands, that is to say, not of this building;
verses.decoded: But Christ came as a high priest of the good things to come, through a greater and more perfect tent, not made by human hands.

verses.kjv: Neither by the blood of goats and calves, but by his own blood he entered in once into the holy place, having obtained eternal redemption for us.
verses.decoded: He did not enter by the blood of goats and calves, but by his own blood, entering once for all into the holy place to obtain eternal redemption.

verses.kjv: For if the blood of bulls and of goats, and the ashes of an heifer sprinkling the unclean, sanctifieth to the purifying of the flesh:
verses.decoded: If the blood of bulls and goats and the ashes of a young cow sprinkled on those who are unclean makes them clean in body,

verses.kjv: How much more shall the blood of Christ, who through the eternal Spirit offered himself without spot to God, purge your conscience from dead works to serve the living God?
verses.decoded: how much more will the blood of Christ, who through the eternal Spirit offered himself without fault to God, cleanse your conscience from dead works to serve the living God?

verses.kjv: And for this cause he is the mediator of the new testament, that by means of death, for the redemption of the transgressions that were under the first testament, they which are called might receive the promise of eternal inheritance.
verses.decoded: That is why he is the mediator of a new agreement, so that by his death, those who are called may receive the promised eternal inheritance because their sins are forgiven.

verses.kjv: For where a testament is, there must also of necessity be the death of the testator.
verses.decoded: Where there is a will, the death of the one who made it must be proven.

verses.kjv: For a testament is of force after men are dead: otherwise it is of no strength at all while the testator liveth.
verses.decoded: A will only takes effect after the person who made it has died; it is not valid while that person is alive.

verses.kjv: Whereupon neither the first testament was dedicated without blood.
verses.decoded: So the first agreement was not dedicated without blood.

verses.kjv: For when Moses had spoken every precept to all the people according to the law, he took the blood of calves and of goats, with water, and scarlet wool, and hyssop, and sprinkled both the book, and all the people,
verses.decoded: When Moses had given all the laws to the people, he took the blood of calves and goats, mixed it with water, scarlet wool, and hyssop, and sprinkled both the book and all the people.

verses.kjv: Saying, This is the blood of the testament which God hath enjoined unto you.
verses.decoded: He said, 'This is the blood of the agreement God has commanded you to keep.'

verses.kjv: Moreover he sprinkled with blood both the tabernacle, and all the vessels of the ministry.
verses.decoded: He also sprinkled the tent and all the tools used in worship with blood.

verses.kjv: And almost all things are by the law purged with blood; and without shedding of blood is no remission.
verses.decoded: Almost everything is purified with blood according to the law, and without the shedding of blood, there is no forgiveness.

verses.kjv: It was therefore necessary that the patterns of things in the heavens should be purified with these; but the heavenly things themselves with better sacrifices than these.
verses.decoded: So it was necessary for the copies of heavenly things to be purified with these sacrifices, but the heavenly things themselves require better sacrifices.

verses.kjv: For Christ is not entered into the holy places made with hands, which are the figures of the true; but into heaven itself, now to appear in the presence of God for us:
verses.decoded: Christ did not enter a sanctuary made by human hands, which is only a copy of the true one, but he entered heaven itself to appear in God's presence for us.

verses.kjv: Nor yet that he should offer himself often, as the high priest entereth into the holy place every year with blood of others;
verses.decoded: He does not need to offer himself repeatedly, as the high priest enters the holy place every year with the blood of others.

verses.kjv: For then must he often have suffered since the foundation of the world: but now once in the end of the world hath he appeared to put away sin by the sacrifice of himself.
verses.decoded: If that were true, he would have had to suffer many times since the world began. But now, at the end of the ages, he appeared once to remove sin by sacrificing himself.

verses.kjv: And as it is appointed unto men once to die, but after this the judgment:
verses.decoded: Just as people are destined to die once and then face judgment,

verses.kjv: So Christ was once offered to bear the sins of many; and unto them that look for him shall he appear the second time without sin unto salvation.
verses.decoded: so Christ was sacrificed once to take away the sins of many. He will appear a second time, not to deal with sin, but to bring salvation to those who are waiting for him.

verses.kjv: For the law having a shadow of good things to come, and not the very image of the things, can never with those sacrifices which they offered year by year continually make the comers thereunto perfect.
verses.decoded: Faith is being sure of what we hope for and certain of what we do not see.

verses.kjv: For then would they not have ceased to be offered? because that the worshippers once purged should have had no more conscience of sins.
verses.decoded: If they could, then the sacrifices would have stopped being offered, because the worshipers would no longer feel guilty about their sins.

verses.kjv: But in those sacrifices there is a remembrance again made of sins every year.
verses.decoded: But with those sacrifices, the memory of sins is brought up again every year.

verses.kjv: For it is not possible that the blood of bulls and of goats should take away sins.
verses.decoded: It is impossible for the blood of bulls and goats to take away sins.

verses.kjv: Wherefore when he cometh into the world, he saith, Sacrifice and offering thou wouldest not, but a body hast thou prepared me:
verses.decoded: So when Christ came into the world, he said, 'You did not want sacrifices and offerings, but you prepared a body for me.'

verses.kjv: In burnt offerings and sacrifices for sin thou hast had no pleasure.
verses.decoded: You were not pleased with burnt offerings and sin offerings.

verses.kjv: Then said I, Lo, I come (in the volume of the book it is written of me,) to do thy will, O God.
verses.decoded: Then I said, 'Here I am, I have come to do your will, O God, as it is written about me in the book.'

verses.kjv: Above when he said, Sacrifice and offering and burnt offerings and offering for sin thou wouldest not, neither hadst pleasure therein; which are offered by the law;
verses.decoded: Earlier, he said, 'You did not want sacrifices and offerings, burnt offerings and sin offerings, which are offered under the law.'

verses.kjv: Then said he, Lo, I come to do thy will, O God. He taketh away the first, that he may establish the second.
verses.decoded: Then he said, 'Here I am, I have come to do your will, O God.' He sets aside the first to establish the second.

verses.kjv: By the which will we are sanctified through the offering of the body of Jesus Christ once for all.
verses.decoded: By that will, we are made holy through the sacrifice of the body of Jesus Christ once and for all.

verses.kjv: And every priest standeth daily ministering and offering oftentimes the same sacrifices, which can never take away sins:
verses.decoded: Every priest stands and serves day after day, offering the same sacrifices that can never take away sins.

verses.kjv: But this man, after he had offered one sacrifice for sins for ever, sat down on the right hand of God;
verses.decoded: But Christ offered one sacrifice for sins forever and then sat down at the right hand of God.

verses.kjv: From henceforth expecting till his enemies be made his footstool.
verses.decoded: He is now waiting until his enemies are made his footstool.

verses.kjv: For by one offering he hath perfected for ever them that are sanctified.
verses.decoded: By one sacrifice, he has made perfect forever those who are being made holy.

verses.kjv: Whereof the Holy Ghost also is a witness to us: for after that he had said before,
verses.decoded: The Holy Spirit also testifies to us about this. After saying before,

verses.kjv: This is the covenant that I will make with them after those days, saith the Lord, I will put my laws into their hearts, and in their minds will I write them;
verses.decoded: 'This is the covenant I will make with them after those days,' says the Lord: 'I will put my laws into their hearts and write them on their minds.'

verses.kjv: And their sins and iniquities will I remember no more.
verses.decoded: And I will no longer remember their sins and lawless acts.

verses.kjv: Now where remission of these is, there is no more offering for sin.
verses.decoded: Where there is forgiveness of these, there is no longer any need for a sacrifice for sin.

verses.kjv: Having therefore, brethren, boldness to enter into the holiest by the blood of Jesus,
verses.decoded: So, brothers and sisters, we have confidence to enter the Most Holy Place by the blood of Jesus,

verses.kjv: By a new and living way, which he hath consecrated for us, through the veil, that is to say, his flesh;
verses.decoded: through a new and living way opened for us through the curtain, that is, his body,

verses.kjv: And having an high priest over the house of God;
verses.decoded: and since we have a great priest over the house of God,

verses.kjv: Let us draw near with a true heart in full assurance of faith, having our hearts sprinkled from an evil conscience, and our bodies washed with pure water.
verses.decoded: let us draw near to God with a sincere heart and full assurance of faith, having our hearts cleansed from a guilty conscience and our bodies washed with pure water.

verses.kjv: Let us hold fast the profession of our faith without wavering; (for he is faithful that promised;)
verses.decoded: Let us hold firmly to the hope we confess, because God can be trusted to keep his promise.

verses.kjv: And let us consider one another to provoke unto love and to good works:
verses.decoded: Let us think about how to encourage each other to show love and do good deeds.

verses.kjv: Not forsaking the assembling of ourselves together, as the manner of some is; but exhorting one another: and so much the more, as ye see the day approaching.
verses.decoded: Do not stop meeting together, as some are in the habit of doing, but encourage each other, especially as you see the day coming.

verses.kjv: For if we sin wilfully after that we have received the knowledge of the truth, there remaineth no more sacrifice for sins,
verses.decoded: If we deliberately keep sinning after we have received the knowledge of the truth, there is no longer any sacrifice that can take away those sins.

verses.kjv: But a certain fearful looking for of judgment and fiery indignation, which shall devour the adversaries.
verses.decoded: Instead, there is only a fearful expectation of judgment and a fire that will consume the enemies of God.

verses.kjv: He that despised Moses' law died without mercy under two or three witnesses:
verses.decoded: Anyone who rejected the law of Moses died without mercy on the testimony of two or three witnesses.

verses.kjv: Of how much sorer punishment, suppose ye, shall he be thought worthy, who hath trodden under foot the Son of God, and hath counted the blood of the covenant, wherewith he was sanctified, an unholy thing, and hath done despite unto the Spirit of grace?
verses.decoded: How much more severely do you think someone deserves to be punished who has trampled the Son of God underfoot, treated the blood of the covenant as an unholy thing, and insulted the Spirit of grace?

verses.kjv: For we know him that hath said, Vengeance belongeth unto me, I will recompense, saith the Lord. And again, The Lord shall judge his people.
verses.decoded: We know the one who said, 'It is mine to avenge; I will repay,' says the Lord. And again, 'The Lord will judge his people.'

verses.kjv: It is a fearful thing to fall into the hands of the living God.
verses.decoded: It is terrifying to fall into the hands of the living God.

verses.kjv: But call to remembrance the former days, in which, after ye were illuminated, ye endured a great fight of afflictions;
verses.decoded: But remember the earlier days when, after you were enlightened, you endured a hard struggle with suffering.

verses.kjv: Partly, whilst ye were made a gazingstock both by reproaches and afflictions; and partly, whilst ye became companions of them that were so used.
verses.decoded: Sometimes you were made a public example by insults and suffering; other times you shared with those who were treated that way.

verses.kjv: For ye had compassion of me in my bonds, and took joyfully the spoiling of your goods, knowing in yourselves that ye have in heaven a better and an enduring substance.
verses.decoded: You showed kindness to me when I was in prison, and you accepted the loss of your property happily, because you knew you have something better and lasting in heaven.

verses.kjv: Cast not away therefore your confidence, which hath great recompence of reward.
verses.decoded: So don’t throw away your confidence, because it will be richly rewarded.

verses.kjv: For ye have need of patience, that, after ye have done the will of God, ye might receive the promise.
verses.decoded: You need to be patient, so that after you have done God’s will, you will receive what he has promised.

verses.kjv: For yet a little while, and he that shall come will come, and will not tarry.
verses.decoded: For in a little while, the one who is coming will come and will not delay.

verses.kjv: Now the just shall live by faith: but if any man draw back, my soul shall have no pleasure in him.
verses.decoded: But the person who lives by faith is righteous. If anyone turns back, I will not be pleased with them.

verses.kjv: But we are not of them who draw back unto perdition; but of them that believe to the saving of the soul.
verses.decoded: But we are not like those who turn away and are lost; we believe and are saved.

verses.kjv: Now faith is the substance of things hoped for, the evidence of things not seen.
verses.decoded: Faith is being sure of what we hope for and certain about things we cannot see.

verses.kjv: For by it the elders obtained a good report.
verses.decoded: Because of faith, the elders received a good reputation.

verses.kjv: Through faith we understand that the worlds were framed by the word of God, so that things which are seen were not made of things which do appear.
verses.decoded: By faith, we understand that the universe was created by God's command, so what we see was made from things that cannot be seen.

verses.kjv: By faith Abel offered unto God a more excellent sacrifice than Cain, by which he obtained witness that he was righteous, God testifying of his gifts: and by it he being dead yet speaketh.
verses.decoded: By faith, Abel offered God a better sacrifice than Cain did, and God accepted Abel's offering as proof that he was righteous. Even though Abel is dead, his faith still speaks to us.

verses.kjv: By faith Enoch was translated that he should not see death; and was not found, because God had translated him: for before his translation he had this testimony, that he pleased God.
verses.decoded: By faith, Enoch was taken up to heaven without dying; he was not found because God took him away. Before that, he was known for pleasing God.

verses.kjv: But without faith it is impossible to please him: for he that cometh to God must believe that he is, and that he is a rewarder of them that diligently seek him.
verses.decoded: Without faith, no one can please God. Anyone who comes to God must believe that He exists and that He rewards those who earnestly seek Him.

verses.kjv: By faith Noah, being warned of God of things not seen as yet, moved with fear, prepared an ark to the saving of his house; by the which he condemned the world, and became heir of the righteousness which is by faith.
verses.decoded: By faith, Noah obeyed God’s warning about things not yet seen. He was afraid and built an ark to save his family. Through this, he condemned the world and became an heir of righteousness because of his faith.

verses.kjv: By faith Abraham, when he was called to go out into a place which he should after receive for an inheritance, obeyed; and he went out, not knowing whither he went.
verses.decoded: By faith, Abraham obeyed when God called him to leave his home and go to a place he would later receive as an inheritance, even though he did not know where he was going.

verses.kjv: By faith he sojourned in the land of promise, as in a strange country, dwelling in tabernacles with Isaac and Jacob, the heirs with him of the same promise:
verses.decoded: By faith, Abraham lived in the promised land as a foreigner, living in tents with Isaac and Jacob, who were also heirs of the same promise.

verses.kjv: For he looked for a city which hath foundations, whose builder and maker is God.
verses.decoded: He was looking forward to a city with solid foundations, a city designed and built by God.

verses.kjv: Through faith also Sara herself received strength to conceive seed, and was delivered of a child when she was past age, because she judged him faithful who had promised.
verses.decoded: By faith, Sarah herself was able to have a child even though she was past the age of having children, because she believed God would keep His promise.

verses.kjv: Therefore sprang there even of one, and him as good as dead, so many as the stars of the sky in multitude, and as the sand which is by the sea shore innumerable.
verses.decoded: So from one man, who was almost dead, came descendants as many as the stars in the sky and as countless as the sand on the seashore.

verses.kjv: These all died in faith, not having received the promises, but having seen them afar off, and were persuaded of them, and embraced them, and confessed that they were strangers and pilgrims on the earth.
verses.decoded: All these people died in faith without receiving what was promised. They only saw it from a distance and welcomed it, admitting that they were strangers and travelers on the earth.

verses.kjv: For they that say such things declare plainly that they seek a country.
verses.decoded: Those who say such things show clearly that they are looking for a homeland.

verses.kjv: And truly, if they had been mindful of that country from whence they came out, they might have had opportunity to have returned.
verses.decoded: If they had been thinking about the country they left, they could have returned there.

verses.kjv: But now they desire a better country, that is, an heavenly: wherefore God is not ashamed to be called their God: for he hath prepared for them a city.
verses.decoded: But now they want a better country, a heavenly one. That is why God is not ashamed to be called their God, because He has prepared a city for them.

verses.kjv: By faith Abraham, when he was tried, offered up Isaac: and he that had received the promises offered up his only begotten son,
verses.decoded: By faith, Abraham, when tested, offered his son Isaac as a sacrifice. The one who had received God's promises was willing to offer his only son.

verses.kjv: Of whom it was said, That in Isaac shall thy seed be called:
verses.decoded: God had said, 'Through Isaac your descendants will be named.'

verses.kjv: Accounting that God was able to raise him up, even from the dead; from whence also he received him in a figure.
verses.decoded: Abraham believed that God could raise Isaac from the dead, and in a way, he did receive him back.

verses.kjv: By faith Isaac blessed Jacob and Esau concerning things to come.
verses.decoded: By faith, Isaac blessed Jacob and Esau in the future.

verses.kjv: By faith Jacob, when he was a dying, blessed both the sons of Joseph; and worshipped, leaning upon the top of his staff.
verses.decoded: By faith, Jacob, as he was dying, blessed the sons of Joseph and worshiped while leaning on his staff.

verses.kjv: By faith Joseph, when he died, made mention of the departing of the children of Israel; and gave commandment concerning his bones.
verses.decoded: By faith, Joseph, before he died, spoke about the Israelites leaving Egypt and gave instructions about his bones.

verses.kjv: By faith Moses, when he was born, was hid three months of his parents, because they saw he was a proper child; and they were not afraid of the king's commandment.
verses.decoded: By faith, Moses' parents hid him for three months after he was born because they saw he was a special child and were not afraid of the king’s order.

verses.kjv: By faith Moses, when he was come to years, refused to be called the son of Pharaoh's daughter;
verses.decoded: By faith, Moses, when he grew up, refused to be called the son of Pharaoh’s daughter.

verses.kjv: Choosing rather to suffer affliction with the people of God, than to enjoy the pleasures of sin for a season;
verses.decoded: He chose to suffer with God's people rather than enjoy the pleasures of sin for a short time.

verses.kjv: Esteeming the reproach of Christ greater riches than the treasures in Egypt: for he had respect unto the recompence of the reward.
verses.decoded: He thought it was better to suffer shame for Christ than to have the treasures of Egypt, because he was looking forward to his reward.

verses.kjv: By faith he forsook Egypt, not fearing the wrath of the king: for he endured, as seeing him who is invisible.
verses.decoded: By faith, Moses left Egypt without fear of the king’s anger. He kept going because he saw the invisible God.

verses.kjv: Through faith he kept the passover, and the sprinkling of blood, lest he that destroyed the firstborn should touch them.
verses.decoded: By faith, Moses kept the Passover and sprinkled the blood so that the destroyer would not harm the firstborn of Israel.

verses.kjv: By faith they passed through the Red sea as by dry land: which the Egyptians assaying to do were drowned.
verses.decoded: By faith, the Israelites crossed the Red Sea as if it were dry land, but the Egyptians who tried to follow were drowned.

verses.kjv: By faith the walls of Jericho fell down, after they were compassed about seven days.
verses.decoded: By faith, the walls of Jericho fell after the Israelites marched around them for seven days.

verses.kjv: By faith the harlot Rahab perished not with them that believed not, when she had received the spies with peace.
verses.decoded: By faith, Rahab the prostitute did not die with those who refused to believe, because she welcomed the spies with peace.

verses.kjv: And what shall I more say? for the time would fail me to tell of Gedeon, and of Barak, and of Samson, and of Jephthae; of David also, and Samuel, and of the prophets:
verses.decoded: What more can I say? I don’t have time to tell about Gideon, Barak, Samson, Jephthah, David, Samuel, and the prophets.

verses.kjv: Who through faith subdued kingdoms, wrought righteousness, obtained promises, stopped the mouths of lions,
verses.decoded: By faith, they conquered kingdoms, did what was right, received promises, and silenced lions.

verses.kjv: Quenched the violence of fire, escaped the edge of the sword, out of weakness were made strong, waxed valiant in fight, turned to flight the armies of the aliens.
verses.decoded: They put out the power of fire, escaped the sword, became strong when weak, fought bravely, and made foreign armies run away.

verses.kjv: Women received their dead raised to life again: and others were tortured, not accepting deliverance; that they might obtain a better resurrection:
verses.decoded: Some women had their dead raised to life again; others were tortured and refused to be saved because they wanted a better resurrection.

verses.kjv: And others had trial of cruel mockings and scourgings, yea, moreover of bonds and imprisonment:
verses.decoded: Others faced cruel mocking and whipping, and even chains and prison.

verses.kjv: They were stoned, they were sawn asunder, were tempted, were slain with the sword: they wandered about in sheepskins and goatskins; being destitute, afflicted, tormented;
verses.decoded: They were stoned, cut in pieces, tested, killed by the sword; they wandered wearing animal skins, poor, suffering, and mistreated.

verses.kjv: (Of whom the world was not worthy:) they wandered in deserts, and in mountains, and in dens and caves of the earth.
verses.decoded: The world was not worthy of them; they wandered in deserts, mountains, caves, and holes in the ground.

verses.kjv: And these all, having obtained a good report through faith, received not the promise:
verses.decoded: All of these were praised for their faith, but they did not receive the promise.

verses.kjv: God having provided some better thing for us, that they without us should not be made perfect.
verses.decoded: God planned something better for us, so that they would not be made perfect without us.

verses.kjv: Wherefore seeing we also are compassed about with so great a cloud of witnesses, let us lay aside every weight, and the sin which doth so easily beset us, and let us run with patience the race that is set before us,
verses.decoded: Since we are surrounded by such a large group of witnesses, let us get rid of every burden and the sin that so easily traps us, and let us run the race with patience that is set before us.

verses.kjv: Looking unto Jesus the author and finisher of our faith; who for the joy that was set before him endured the cross, despising the shame, and is set down at the right hand of the throne of God.
verses.decoded: Keep your eyes on Jesus, the one who started and perfects our faith. He endured the cross because of the joy waiting for him, ignoring the shame, and now sits at the right side of God's throne.

verses.kjv: For consider him that endured such contradiction of sinners against himself, lest ye be wearied and faint in your minds.
verses.decoded: Think about Jesus, who endured such opposition from sinners against himself, so you don’t get tired and lose heart.

verses.kjv: Ye have not yet resisted unto blood, striving against sin.
verses.decoded: You have not yet fought against sin to the point of death.

verses.kjv: And ye have forgotten the exhortation which speaketh unto you as unto children, My son, despise not thou the chastening of the Lord, nor faint when thou art rebuked of him:
verses.decoded: You have forgotten the encouragement that speaks to you like a father to his children: 'My son, don’t ignore the Lord’s discipline, and don’t give up when he corrects you.'

verses.kjv: For whom the Lord loveth he chasteneth, and scourgeth every son whom he receiveth.
verses.decoded: The Lord disciplines those he loves and punishes every son he accepts.

verses.kjv: If ye endure chastening, God dealeth with you as with sons; for what son is he whom the father chasteneth not?
verses.decoded: If you accept discipline, God treats you like his children. For what son is not disciplined by his father?

verses.kjv: But if ye be without chastisement, whereof all are partakers, then are ye bastards, and not sons.
verses.decoded: But if you are not disciplined, and everyone shares in this discipline, then you are not true sons but illegitimate children.

verses.kjv: Furthermore we have had fathers of our flesh which corrected us, and we gave them reverence: shall we not much rather be in subjection unto the Father of spirits, and live?
verses.decoded: We had human fathers who corrected us and we respected them. Shouldn’t we be even more willing to submit to the Father of spirits and live?

verses.kjv: For they verily for a few days chastened us after their own pleasure; but he for our profit, that we might be partakers of his holiness.
verses.decoded: Those fathers disciplined us for a short time as they thought best, but God disciplines us for our good, so we can share in his holiness.

verses.kjv: Wherefore lift up the hands which hang down, and the feeble knees;
verses.decoded: So strengthen your weak hands and weak knees.

verses.kjv: And make straight paths for your feet, lest that which is lame be turned out of the way; but let it rather be healed.
verses.decoded: Make straight paths for your feet so that those who are lame won’t be turned out of the way but will be healed.

verses.kjv: Follow peace with all men, and holiness, without which no man shall see the Lord:
verses.decoded: Work for peace with everyone and for holiness, because without holiness no one will see the Lord.

verses.kjv: Looking diligently lest any man fail of the grace of God; lest any root of bitterness springing up trouble you, and thereby many be defiled;
verses.decoded: Be careful that no one misses the grace of God and that no bitter root grows up to cause trouble and make many unclean.

verses.kjv: Lest there be any fornicator, or profane person, as Esau, who for one morsel of meat sold his birthright.
verses.decoded: Don’t be immoral or godless like Esau, who sold his birthright for a single meal.

verses.kjv: For ye know how that afterward, when he would have inherited the blessing, he was rejected: for he found no place of repentance, though he sought it carefully with tears.
verses.decoded: You know that later, when he wanted to inherit the blessing, he was rejected. He found no chance to repent, even though he tried with tears.

verses.kjv: For ye are not come unto the mount that might be touched, and that burned with fire, nor unto blackness, and darkness, and tempest,
verses.decoded: You have not come to a mountain that can be touched or that is burning with fire, darkness, gloom, and a storm.

verses.kjv: And the sound of a trumpet, and the voice of words; which voice they that heard intreated that the word should not be spoken to them any more:
verses.decoded: You have not come to the sound of a trumpet or to the voice of words that those who heard begged not to hear again.

verses.kjv: (For they could not endure that which was commanded, And if so much as a beast touch the mountain, it shall be stoned, or thrust through with a dart:
verses.decoded: They could not bear what was commanded: if even an animal touched the mountain, it had to be stoned or killed with a spear. The sight was so terrifying that Moses said, 'I am trembling with fear.'

verses.kjv: And so terrible was the sight, that Moses said, I exceedingly fear and quake:)
verses.decoded: The sight was so frightening that Moses said, 'I am very afraid and shaking.'

verses.kjv: To the general assembly and church of the firstborn, which are written in heaven, and to God the Judge of all, and to the spirits of just men made perfect,
verses.decoded: You have come to the assembly of the firstborn whose names are written in heaven, to God the judge of all, and to the spirits of the righteous made perfect.

verses.kjv: And to Jesus the mediator of the new covenant, and to the blood of sprinkling, that speaketh better things than that of Abel.
verses.decoded: You have come to Jesus, the mediator of the new agreement, and to the sprinkled blood that speaks better than the blood of Abel.

verses.kjv: See that ye refuse not him that speaketh. For if they escaped not who refused him that spake on earth, much more shall not we escape, if we turn away from him that speaketh from heaven:
verses.decoded: Be careful not to refuse the one who speaks. If those who refused the one who spoke on earth did not escape punishment, how much more will we be punished if we turn away from the one who speaks from heaven?

verses.kjv: Whose voice then shook the earth: but now he hath promised, saying, Yet once more I shake not the earth only, but also heaven.
verses.decoded: His voice shook the earth then, but now he has promised, saying, 'Once more I will shake not only the earth but also the heavens.'

verses.kjv: And this word, Yet once more, signifieth the removing of those things that are shaken, as of things that are made, that those things which cannot be shaken may remain.
verses.decoded: The phrase 'once more' means removing what can be shaken, so that what cannot be shaken will remain.

verses.kjv: Wherefore we receiving a kingdom which cannot be moved, let us have grace, whereby we may serve God acceptably with reverence and godly fear:
verses.decoded: Therefore, since we are receiving a kingdom that cannot be shaken, let us be thankful and offer God acceptable worship with reverence and awe.

verses.kjv: For our God is a consuming fire.
verses.decoded: Our God is a consuming fire.

verses.kjv: Let brotherly love continue.
verses.decoded: Let brotherly love continue.

verses.kjv: Be not forgetful to entertain strangers: for thereby some have entertained angels unawares.
verses.decoded: Don't forget to welcome strangers, because some have welcomed angels without knowing it.

verses.kjv: Remember them that are in bonds, as bound with them; and them which suffer adversity, as being yourselves also in the body.
verses.decoded: Remember those in prison as if you were in prison with them, and those who suffer as if you were suffering too.

verses.kjv: Marriage is honourable in all, and the bed undefiled: but whoremongers and adulterers God will judge.
verses.decoded: Marriage should be honored by everyone, and the marriage bed kept pure. But God will judge those who are immoral and those who commit adultery.

verses.kjv: Let your conversation be without covetousness; and be content with such things as ye have: for he hath said, I will never leave thee, nor forsake thee.
verses.decoded: Keep your lives free from the love of money and be content with what you have, because God has said, 'I will never leave you or abandon you.'

verses.kjv: So that we may boldly say, The Lord is my helper, and I will not fear what man shall do unto me.
verses.decoded: So we can confidently say, 'The Lord is my helper; I will not be afraid of what anyone can do to me.'

verses.kjv: Remember them which have the rule over you, who have spoken unto you the word of God: whose faith follow, considering the end of their conversation.
verses.decoded: Remember your leaders who spoke God's word to you. Follow their faith and consider the outcome of their way of life.

verses.kjv: Jesus Christ the same yesterday, and to day, and for ever.
verses.decoded: Jesus Christ is the same yesterday, today, and forever.

verses.kjv: Be not carried about with divers and strange doctrines. For it is a good thing that the heart be established with grace; not with meats, which have not profited them that have been occupied therein.
verses.decoded: Don't be carried away by strange teachings. It is good for your heart to be strengthened by grace, not by eating certain foods, which don't help those who follow them.

verses.kjv: We have an altar, whereof they have no right to eat which serve the tabernacle.
verses.decoded: We have an altar that those who serve the tabernacle have no right to eat from.

verses.kjv: For the bodies of those beasts, whose blood is brought into the sanctuary by the high priest for sin, are burned without the camp.
verses.decoded: The bodies of the animals whose blood the high priest brings into the sanctuary to make atonement for sin are burned outside the camp.

verses.kjv: Wherefore Jesus also, that he might sanctify the people with his own blood, suffered without the gate.
verses.decoded: So Jesus also suffered outside the city gate to make the people holy by his own blood.

verses.kjv: Let us go forth therefore unto him without the camp, bearing his reproach.
verses.decoded: Let us go to him outside the camp, carrying the shame he bore.

verses.kjv: For here have we no continuing city, but we seek one to come.
verses.decoded: We do not have a permanent city here, but we are looking for the city that is coming.

verses.kjv: By him therefore let us offer the sacrifice of praise to God continually, that is, the fruit of our lips giving thanks to his name.
verses.decoded: Through Jesus, let us continually offer to God a sacrifice of praise—the fruit of lips that openly declare his name.

verses.kjv: But to do good and to communicate forget not: for with such sacrifices God is well pleased.
verses.decoded: And don't forget to do good and share with others, because these are the sacrifices that please God.

verses.kjv: Obey them that have the rule over you, and submit yourselves: for they watch for your souls, as they that must give account, that they may do it with joy, and not with grief: for that is unprofitable for you.
verses.decoded: Obey your leaders and submit to them, because they keep watch over your souls and must give an account. Let them do this with joy, not with grief, because that would be harmful to you.

verses.kjv: Pray for us: for we trust we have a good conscience, in all things willing to live honestly.
verses.decoded: Pray for us, because we are sure we have a clear conscience and want to live honorably in every way.

verses.kjv: But I beseech you the rather to do this, that I may be restored to you the sooner.
verses.decoded: I ask you to pray for me so that I may be restored to you quickly.

verses.kjv: Now the God of peace, that brought again from the dead our Lord Jesus, that great shepherd of the sheep, through the blood of the everlasting covenant,
verses.decoded: Now may the God of peace, who brought back from the dead our Lord Jesus, the great shepherd of the sheep, by the blood of the eternal covenant,

verses.kjv: Make you perfect in every good work to do his will, working in you that which is wellpleasing in his sight, through Jesus Christ; to whom be glory for ever and ever. Amen.
verses.decoded: make you perfect in every good work to do his will. May he work in you what pleases him through Jesus Christ, to whom be glory forever and ever. Amen.

verses.kjv: And I beseech you, brethren, suffer the word of exhortation: for I have written a letter unto you in few words.
verses.decoded: Brothers and sisters, I urge you to accept this message of encouragement, because I have written to you briefly.

verses.kjv: Know ye that our brother Timothy is set at liberty; with whom, if he come shortly, I will see you.
verses.decoded: Know that our brother Timothy has been released. If he comes soon, I will visit you with him.

verses.kjv: Salute all them that have the rule over you, and all the saints. They of Italy salute you.
verses.decoded: Give my greetings to all your leaders and all the believers. Those from Italy send you their greetings.

verses.kjv: Grace be with you all. Amen. Written to the Hebrews from Italy by Timothy.
verses.decoded: May grace be with you all. Amen.
